name: io.github.hellosverre/ghidralens
description: Interactive Ghidra views in your AI client: decompile, rename, and navigate a binary.

environmentVariables.name: GHIDRALENS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret printed by the PyGhidra bridge on startup. Start the bridge first: python bridge/serve.py --binary <path>

environmentVariables.name: GHIDRALENS_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the PyGhidra bridge is listening. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8799
